response.overview: Namibia is home to the largest population of cheetahs in the world, and one woman has made it her life's mission to protect them, ensuring that they do not go extinct. For the last 30 years, Dr. Laurie Marker, founder of the Cheetah Conservation Fund (CCF), has been dedicated to saving cheetahs in the wild, and she's beginning to see her efforts make a difference. In Return of the Cheetah, biologist and conservationist Hazen Audel, joins Dr. Marker in Namibia to discover the impact that CCF's efforts have had on the lives of these majestic animals. And as if seeing cheetahs up closer weren't already thrilling enough for Hazen, he is given the opportunity to take part in a truly meaningful experience; releasing a rehabilitated cheetah back into the wild.
response.title: Return Of The Cheetah
